en.quote: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman; let him declare what he seeth! . And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
en.riddle: Go, set a watchman; let him declare what he seeth!
en.speaker: the Lord

he.quote: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֵלַי אֲדֹנָי לֵךְ הַעֲמֵד הַמְצַפֶּה, אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה יַגִּיד. וְרָאָה רֶכֶב צֶמֶד פָּֽרָשִׁים רֶכֶב חֲמוֹר רֶכֶב גָּמָל וְהִקְשִׁיב קֶשֶׁב רַב-קָֽשֶׁב
he.riddle: לֵךְ הַעֲמֵד הַמְצַפֶּה, אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה יַגִּיד.
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
